test_note_transform_never_external reads the note before the editor's autosave commit (an intermittent failure, about 1 in 7 runs on both 7cd1111 and the final tree with the same signature). M09-C110 attributes it by barrier: holding only the revision commit reproduces it deterministically; holding only the Hub's publication changes nothing.
